column2: [intro]
In the zones of limits, each has their own ground,
Where we explore our boundaries, unique and profound.
The passion within drives us to discover,
With each challenge faced, we feel reborn, recover.
In the zones of limits, adventure's on the rise,
Where everything is possible, and rules relax in disguise.
We push past our limits, beyond the confines and walls,
It’s in these moments that strength and growth calls.
Every limit’s a challenge to embrace,
On a new level, a new space to trace.
It’s thrilling to see how far we can soar,
Without stopping, without feeling sore.
